page.overview:
Who is Black Samson?

Markus Grimshaw, also known as Black Samson, is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a member of the Guardians of the Globe. He was once part of the Guardians original roster until he lost his powers and left the team. He would later rejoin the team under Robot’s command.

In his youth, Black Samson was already a tall and exceptionally muscular man, possessing a broad chest, thick arms, wide shoulders, and a powerful athletic build. He had dark skin, short black hair, and a relatively smooth, youthful face. Even at this stage of his career, his physique was notably bulky and imposing.

As an older man, Black Samson retains his tall, heavily muscular physique, with broad shoulders, a large chest, thick arms, and a powerful overall build. He is bald and has a more mature appearance, with prominent facial lines around his eyes, cheeks, and mouth. His facial features are strong and angular, including a broad nose, pronounced cheekbones, and a defined jaw.
